summary: Building the log-intelligence backend that helps the team investigate, triage and resolve production errors — from raw Elasticsearch/Kibana logs to an MCP-based AI assistant that reasons about them.
highlights: Built the log retrieval API and storage architecture — Elasticsearch/Kibana in, structured MongoDB + Azure Blob out
Shipped Lucy's prompter workflow, an MCP AI assistant that reasons over active production errors

milestones.title: Log Retrieval API
milestones.description: Developed an API to retrieve and filter Kibana/Elasticsearch logs by error type, environment, agent, batch ID, transaction ID and other operational attributes — a structured interface for investigating error data.

milestones.title: Log Storage Architecture
milestones.description: Designed the log-storage workflow to persist searchable error metadata in MongoDB, while storing complete log payloads in Azure Blob Storage, organised around batch and transaction identifiers.

milestones.title: Large-Scale Log Crawler
milestones.description: Built a crawler to process large volumes of Elasticsearch logs, implementing pagination to overcome the 10,000-result retrieval limit. Added persistent checkpoints in a dedicated MongoDB collection so interrupted crawls resume from their last successful position.

milestones.title: Error-Lifecycle Logic
milestones.description: Implemented logic to determine whether errors are active or resolved, ensuring only relevant ongoing incidents are surfaced for further processing.

milestones.title: Lucy — MCP AI Assistant Integration
milestones.description: Developed a prompter workflow for Lucy, the company's MCP-based AI assistant, to send structured context about active errors and persist Lucy's responses — including error details, reasons for continued activity, and suggested resolution actions.

milestones.title: Role-Based Authorization for Lucy
milestones.description: Currently developing a role-based authorisation layer for Lucy, to validate user permissions before allowing access to potentially restricted operational information.

summary: Worked on an AI-driven predictive maintenance system for Metro Rail assets, turning fault-event and IoT sensor data into failure-prediction insight.
highlights: Built the EDA & feature-engineering pipeline that fed the failure-prediction models
Researched predictive-maintenance methods for metro rail assets with the team

milestones.title: Predictive Maintenance Pipeline
milestones.description: Ran exploratory data analysis, validation and feature engineering on sensor and maintenance datasets to feed fault-event-based failure prediction.

milestones.title: Reliability Research
milestones.description: Researched predictive-maintenance methodologies with the team to help reduce unplanned breakdowns and improve maintenance planning.
